rows.label: Tier 1
rows.description: Personal or team use. Reads, or changes only the person's own items. No sensitive data.

rows.label: Tier 2
rows.description: Department use. Changes shared data as the signed-in person, or touches internal data.

rows.label: Tier 3
rows.description: Acts under its own identity, touches restricted data, reaches the whole organization or outside users, or executes changes as an agent.
